The '''Antiviral kit MK-2''' was manufactured by [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]]. It provided temporary immunity to the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] as long as it was equipped. The [[Antiviral kit MK-1]] was a weaker version and the [[Antiviral kit MK-3]] was a more powerful version. [[Captain/Legends|Captains]] [[Erimus Moayoi]] and [[Lahoa Diatog]] of THORN sold Antiviral kit MK-2s.<ref name="Cartel" />
